home.title: I'm Gerardo Medina Romero
home.description: Senior Frontend Engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable web applications for global products used by millions. I specialize in React, TypeScript, frontend architecture, and full-stack development with Node.js.

about.title: Profile
about.aboutme: I drive engineering improvements through automation and AI while collaborating with global, cross-functional teams at Rakuten and Microsoft. I care about accessible, maintainable software that delivers measurable business impact.
about.workAuthorization: Based in Tokyo with valid authorization to work in Japan.

highlights: Develop frontend and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) solutions for Rakuten Ichiba using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Redux, and REST APIs.
Redesigned and optimized Purchase History for better usability, maintainability, and frontend performance; added English, Chinese, and Korean localization to server-rendered experiences.
Contributed to Social Gift from architecture and implementation through production release and post-launch support.
Built and shipped 20+ reusable UI components for consistent desktop and mobile experiences.

Own features from technical investigation and specification through integration testing, QA, UAT support, release coordination, and production support; support major sales events with performance and load testing and production monitoring.
Developed an AI-powered pull request reviewer to improve code quality and reduce manual review effort.
worktimeline.environment: Work within a large-scale e-commerce platform, collaborating across frontend and backend teams and supporting containerized delivery, production monitoring, and incident response.

highlights: Delivered customer-facing features for Microsoft Viva Engage across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
Improved screen-reader and high-contrast experiences and introduced Latin American Spanish localization.
Contributed to the Yammer-to-Viva Engage transition and AI-powered duplicate-question detection.
Built integrated experiences with Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and OneDrive engineering teams.
Expanded reactions and implemented the new Microsoft emoji system.
Delivered frontend features for an enterprise recruitment platform supporting SoFi.
Improved maintainability through reusable components and API integrations.
Delivered scalable candidate-screening workflows for Sterling's enterprise recruitment software.
Built frontend and backend product functionality with distributed engineering teams.
Designed and built the Virtual Campus to centralize courses, coding exercises, and job opportunities, leading frontend architecture and technology selection.
Taught MERN Stack bootcamps and mentored hundreds of students across Mexico, Costa Rica, and Colombia.
Built the company's primary web platform from the ground up.
Worked directly with the founders to design and release customer-facing capabilities.

dataportfolio.title: Rakuten Ichiba
dataportfolio.description: I develop frontend and Node.js BFF solutions for Rakuten Ichiba. I redesigned Purchase History, added English, Chinese, and Korean localization to its server-rendered experience, and shipped 20+ reusable UI components. I also contributed to Social Gift from architecture through launch and post-launch support, with responsibilities spanning testing, release coordination, and production reliability.

dataportfolio.title: Microsoft Viva Engage
dataportfolio.description: I built customer-facing features for Microsoft Viva Engage within Microsoft 365, collaborating with Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and OneDrive teams. My work included the Yammer-to-Viva Engage transition, AI-powered duplicate-question detection, screen-reader and high-contrast improvements, Latin American Spanish localization, and expanded reactions with the new Microsoft emoji system.

dataportfolio.title: DEV.F
dataportfolio.description: I designed and built DEV.F’s Virtual Campus to bring courses, coding exercises, and job opportunities into one platform, leading frontend architecture and technology selection. Alongside product development, I taught MERN Stack bootcamps and mentored hundreds of aspiring engineers in Mexico, Costa Rica, and Colombia.
